title: Remembering with static
description:
Write in `solution.c`, using `static` local variables:

```c
int next_id(void);          /* 1 the first time, then 2, 3, ... */
int running_total(int add); /* adds to a total kept between calls and returns it */
int calls_so_far(void);     /* how many times calls_so_far itself has been called, including this one */
```

The tests call each function several times in a row, so the values must survive between calls. No global variables.
